body.x: Kwilt articipated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a home IoT device capable of storing large-scale memories, “Kwilt Shoebox.”A new home IoT device, “Kwilt Shoebox” developed by an innovative enterprise specialized in personal media solutions, Kwilt, can be extended in storage capacity through USB drives and memory sticks in case more of the storage capacity is needed. This product is based on the platforms of cloud, social and home, and personal media aggregation. Updated user interface of this product added video support and phone memories offload.Representative of Kwilt, Marc-Antoine Benglia said, “the users don’t have to erase their files to secure more storage capacity of their smartphones, nor do they have to pay the continuously-increasing monthly fees for the cloud services. They can easily put their personal memories into their personal devices and access to them whenever and wherever.”CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
